# Pdfino

> Pdfino is an iPhone and iPad app with 39 PDF tools, by Visto Apps (https://vistoapps.com). It compresses PDF file size, and scans, merges, splits, signs, fills, protects, redacts and converts PDFs on the device, with no account and no file uploaded to a Pdfino server.

Platforms: iOS and iPadOS 17.0 or later. Price model: free to download, with ads and daily limits; a subscription removes the limits and the ads, and the App Store shows the price for your region. Available in English and Romanian on this site.
